quarterly_data.quarter: Parade Technologies press release: UGREEN Unveils High-Performance USB4 Hub Powered by Parade (10-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer UGREEN: Parade announced that UGREEN has selected Parade's chipset for its flagship USB4 Hub - the USB-IF certified PS9010 USB4 dock controller and the PS5513 dual-port USB Power Delivery controller (the hub adds USB4 daisy-chain, USB 3.2 10Gbps / 5Gbps ports, 2.5GBase-T Ethernet, card readers and HDMI output driven from the PS9010's native DisplayPort interface). The PS9010 is in mass production now, in an 8.5mm x 11.5mm 274-ball BGA package.
quarterly_data.figure: PS9010 in mass production; 8.5mm x 11.5mm 274-ball BGA
